description.zh: 检索范围起始时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The start time of the query range. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

description.zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。页数从1开始排序。
description.en: The page number to return. Pages start from 1.

description.zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的**设备**页查看**DeviceName**。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**ProductKey**。
></notice>
description.en:
The name of the IPC device.
You can view **DeviceName** on the **Devices** page of the IoT Platform console.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>.

description.zh: 检索范围结束时间，格式为13位时间戳，单位为毫秒。
description.en: The end time of the query range. The value is a 13-digit UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

description.zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>
description.en:
The ID of the IPC device. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device. You can call [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) of IoT Platform to query the ID.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** is a globally unique identifier for the device and corresponds one-to-one with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page of the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If <props="intl"><ph>the **Instance Overview** page or </ph></props>no ID value exists, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh: 每页显示的条数。默认值为10，最大值为50。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50.

The image source. Valid values:

- **0** (default): all events.
- **1**: alert event capture.
- **2**: active capture.
- **3**: other.
- **4**: cloud screenshot.

The image type. Valid values:

- **0**: thumbnail. 
- **1**: original image.
- **2** (default): all.

description.zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台**产品**页查看或调用[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>
description.en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the **Products** page of the IoT Platform console, or call [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) to query information about all products under the current account.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为500。

> 单个阿里云账号下的所有RAM用户共享该阿里云账号的配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) per Alibaba Cloud account for this operation is 500.

> All Resource Access Management (RAM) users under a single Alibaba Cloud account share this quota.
